description: This file defines the VTScheduledReport class, a subclass of Reports, responsible for managing scheduled report generation, including retrieving schedule info, determining next trigger times, sending report emails with attachments, and managing recipients within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VTScheduledReport
classes.description: Class managing the scheduling, retrieval, and execution of automated reports within vtiger CRM, including email dispatch and recipient handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database and user context, optionally associating with a specific report ID.

methods.name: getReportScheduleInfo
methods.description: Fetches and caches the scheduling information for a report.

methods.name: getRecipientEmails
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses for scheduled report recipients, including users, roles, and groups.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Constructs and dispatches the report email with appropriate attachments to recipients.

methods.name: getNextTriggerTime
methods.description: Calculates the next scheduled time for report execution based on the defined schedule interval.

methods.name: updateNextTriggerTime
methods.description: Updates the database with the next trigger time after report execution.

methods.name: generateRecipientOption
methods.description: Creates HTML option elements for recipients of various types (users, roles, groups).

methods.name: getSelectedRecipientsHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying the currently selected recipients.

methods.name: getAvailableUsersHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for a selectable list of all users.

methods.name: getAvailableGroupsHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for a list of all groups.

methods.name: getAvailableRolesHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for all role options.

methods.name: getAvailableRolesAndSubordinatesHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for roles and their subordinates.

methods.name: getScheduledReports
methods.description: Retrieves all reports scheduled for execution at or before the current time.

methods.name: runScheduledReports
methods.description: Executes the scheduled reports whose trigger times have arrived, and updates their next trigger times.
